label: Trenton Merricks, Précis of Truth and…: Only truths about the mere existence of something must…
locator: PDF p. 3, paragraph beginning Truth and Ontology concludes
interpretation: The necessity demand is restricted to mere-existence truths. Merricks still rejects the doctrine Truthmaker rather than endorsing it with curtailed scope. The analyst per-individual ExistenceScope is narrower and not identified with this whole class.
attribution: The passage states that only truths about mere existence must have truthmakers, which is the premise.
